description: Synthetic Google-login phishing: 'unusual sign-in' lure from a non-Google domain, link host contains the brand token.

email.subject: Security alert: unusual sign-in attempt
email.body_text:
We detected an unusual sign-in to your Google Account from a new device.
If this wasn't you, sign in now to confirm your account or it will be locked within 12 hours.
https://google-account-recovery.test/signin?continue=mail

The Google Accounts team
